name: lb64_item_check_p16
long_context_execution: all arms: memory-linear GLOBAL causal / LOCAL sliding prefill via the 64-row kernel, elided O(n^2) prefill mask mapping, token-chunked MoE (V27_PREFILL_DENSE64=1); canvas calls follow each arm | decoding substrate piecewise_v1 (torch 2.12.1 grouped_mm MoE; decoder compiled reduce-overhead, split at GLOBAL attention which runs eager; LOCAL attention graphed unless the arm routes LOCAL layers; official-style compiled sampler); untimed per-arm warm-up before timed requests
selection_rule: P16 held-out item check (2026-10-02): the 64K main-vs-dense accuracy gap over E13-E15 (228 vs 238 of 432, item-clustered p 0.29) concentrates in a few items. The 3 items with the most negative and the 3 with the most positive main-minus-dense correct count were frozen from E13-E15 only (discover on those panels) and are re-run on 12 never-used seeds (2222..3333) to test whether the per-item drops reproduce. Arms: dense FA4, main M3 + c0 (-ln2), main + output protection (generated-token key tiles never skipped), and main at the more conservative -2ln2 threshold. Three hosts, one host per cell; substrate piecewise_v5; frozen before generation.
